@graph.name: Website Audits for National Tourism Boards
@graph.description: Travelers start getting to know a country on its official tourism website: destinations, entry requirements, and news. Errors and outdated information on such a website undermine trust in the country as a travel destination. We have reviewed websites of national and regional tourism boards.

@graph.name: Website Audits for National Tourism Boards

mainEntity.name: What do you check on a tourism board website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Destination pages, entry requirements, news, contacts, language switching, and whether the information matches the primary version of the website.

mainEntity.name: Do you need access to the website's content management system?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We review the website the way your customers see it. All we need to start is the website address and a business email.
